# Personal website feature audit

Reviewed September 14, 2026. This is an audit of the local source and selected interactions on the deployed site, not a complete link or accessibility certification.

## Changes in this update

- Added Adobe / Research Intern / Firefly team / June–September 2026 to `_data/cv.yml` and the homepage biography. Description: research on OPD for few-step text-to-image generation, developing methods to distill multi-step teachers into few-step students. Method details remain undisclosed; no performance claims or expansion of OPD were invented.
- Fixed experience dates to retain months, including same-year internships. Empty end dates display Present; year-only dates remain supported. Date badges can wrap in narrow columns.
- Removed empty skill-level parentheses from the web CV. The deployed page showed headings such as “Programming Languages ():”.

## Template features to leave out until there is real content

`nav: false` hides a navigation entry; it does not exclude the page from the build. The current exclusions only remove the Einstein about page among the template pages.

| Feature                                             | Current state                                                                                                                                                                    | Recommendation and implementation                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| --------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Blog, RSS, and external imports                     | Hidden blog page, example posts, and configured imports from al-folio's Medium feed and Google Blog remain. The external-posts plugin iterates over those sources during builds. | Exclude demo posts and the blog page and clear `external_sources` until you publish original writing. Disable unused archive generation. If adding a blog later, give it your title, original posts, and your own feeds.                                          |
| Projects and repository cards                       | Hidden pages remain; repository data lists torvalds, alshedivat, and template dependencies.                                                                                      | Research project pages could be useful later, but current paper Website/Code buttons already serve that purpose. Exclude sample pages and collections now; enable a curated project page only with your actual projects. Load Masonry only on pages that need it. |
| Bookshelf, people, and course demos                 | Template collections and hidden pages remain. The real Teaching page is a simple list of your TA roles.                                                                          | Exclude demo pages and collection documents without deleting the reusable source. Keep the real Teaching page. A people page makes sense only for a lab/group site.                                                                                               |
| Comments and newsletter                             | Giscus lacks repository/category configuration; newsletter is disabled and has no endpoint.                                                                                      | Keep disabled. Configure these only alongside an actively maintained blog/newsletter.                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Analytics                                           | Disabled and account identifiers are empty.                                                                                                                                      | Optional, not necessary to repair the public site. Enable only if there is a concrete need to measure traffic.                                                                                                                                                    |
| Global math, image zoom, progress bar, fixed footer | Several optional scripts load on every page. Math can be useful for technical writing; zoom can help diagrams.                                                                   | Scope optional scripts to pages that use them. The fixed footer and progress bar are aesthetic choices, not confirmed failures; test them on small screens before deciding whether to remove them.                                                                |

## Recommended order

1. Verify and deploy the internship and small CV fixes.
2. Repair the web/PDF CV synchronization so visitors download the same experience they see online.
3. Exclude demo pages, demo collections, unrelated external imports, and stale template data from publication.
4. Populate coauthor links and improve sharing metadata.
5. Add optional research projects, blog features, or citation counts only when there is content to support them.

## Validation limits

- Live checks covered homepage rendering, BIB expansion, author expansion, light/dark switching, CV contents, and an Experience section jump.
- Docker and Ruby are unavailable on this machine, so the required full Jekyll build and a local rendered preview could not run.
- The linked PDF, all external links, clipboard copying, mobile navigation, image zoom, and scheduled GitHub Actions were not comprehensively tested.
- Broader feature cleanup is a recommendation; this update does not remove demo content or change deployed feature flags.
